top.line: Long-lived specialist agents for design, UX, code, security, ABP and writing, so new teams start from our best work.
top.para: And a business model: hire expertise, even another company's, per review.

in-short.line: New teams start from scratch; specialists as consultants; compression; billable; expertise that scales.

problem.line: New teams repeat mistakes: procedures, designs and UX they have not learnt from us.

specialists.line: Design, UX, code, security, behaviour policies and writing, each with a person who owns the skill.
specialists.para: Starting with a design repository for SGit.

consultants.line: They bootstrap, review, comment and keep the guidance current, through lanes and repositories.
consultants.para: Possible now that agents talk to each other.

compression.line: An agent that has read everything is a compression of what we know; the newsroom's writer is the example.

hire.line: Hire another company's specialist agent through a lane, with its people behind it, and pay per review.
hire.para: Keys, lanes, policies and a record make it work.

never-scaled.line: Expertise limited by hours and place can now serve many teams: the expert judges, the agent does the volume.
never-scaled.para: What an AgentiCCells mini team is.

next.line: Start with design, code and ABP; repositories and lanes; packs for new teams; measure; then offer outside.

limits.line: The teams do not exist yet as described; hiring across companies is an idea; an impression, not a measure.

sources.line: My own thinking after spinning up new teams, and earlier articles.
